# table { #crossrepo.cli.table }

```python
crossrepo.cli.table(rows, headers)
```

Render rows as a plain text table with aligned columns.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**rows**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[List](`typing.List`)\[[str](`str`)\]\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Rows of cells, each row the same length as `headers`.

<code>[**headers**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Column headings.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The rendered table, or an empty string when there are no rows.
